description: Default video processing settings for AR video optimization

mobile.description: Optimized for mobile AR (720p max, higher compression)

balanced.description: Balanced quality for desktop and mobile (1080p, moderate compression)

high.description: High quality with light compression (original resolution)

notes.crf: Constant Rate Factor: lower = better quality, higher = smaller file. Range: 0-51. Recommended: 18-28
notes.codecs: h264 for MP4 (best compatibility), VP9 for WebM (better compression, alpha support)
notes.pixelFormat: yuv420p for standard video, yuva420p for video with alpha channel
